contractName: Operation Stilleto: Caught in a Mosh
missionSuccessStatementOverride: Good job.  Even with Grim Determination complicating the situation did not deter us with the ideal outcome.
shortDescription: Operation STILETTO A battalion of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[kosLoreKalskagCoalition],Band of the Damned]] has broken off and is trying to escape the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[kosLoreTaskForceAcamar],Task Force]]'s push in the area. If they get away, they could regroup and cause problems later. [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[kosLoreAntonCorrigan],Corrigan]] doesn't have any forces left to deal with them. All of his units are already tied up fighting in their own sector. Corrigan is asking us to take care of the breakaway group before they can slip past friendly lines or swing around for a flank. Objective: Intercept and engage the escaping Band of the Damned and keep them from outmaneuvering the Corrigan's forces. ALLOWS UP TO MAX UNITS per Argo Upgrade This is a modified Warzone; Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
longDescription: Stop the escape: cut them off, then close.

contractObjectiveList.title: Engage Band of the Damned forces retreating or flanking the task force

objectiveList.title: Get 1 unit to the rally point
Defeat Red Wake (Band of the Damned - Wave 1)
Defeat Gravebound (Band of the Damned - Wave 2)
Defeat Burning Saints (Band of the Damned - Wave 3)
Defeat Iron Damnation (Band of the Damned - Wave 4)
Defeat Grim Host (Band of the Damned - Wave 5)

dialogueContent.words: Contact!  Band of the Damned elements marked!
Copy...wait, they're already in heavy contact.  Corrigan's army sure moves fast.
Negative!  No active task force in the sector --- repeat, not in sector.

This is Task Force Acamar Buffalo Actual --- that's Grim Determination, a supporter of Noru, engaging the Band of the Damned.

So, this is where they were hiding.  They must be the one bombarding the area.

Noted.

Commander, I suggest we let those two groups have at it.  The other merc group must be itching for revenge with the Band of the Damned leaving the Coalition.
Our reinforcing troops on your way are delayed due to heavy artillery fire.  They're adjusting their movement path to maintain safety while consolidating at your position.
It's better to quickly dispatch that lance, so that my Cutlass Company can reach you faster and relieve your position, allowing your forces to disengage.

{MC.If.Encounter.HasNoTag.megakill}Head up back to the camp.  We'll touch base once we've completed this operation.

Corrigan, out.
We failed.
{COMPANY.CompanyName}, this is Cutlass Actual.  We're at your position.  Took heavy hits coming in --- lost half our people.
{MC.If.Encounter.HasTag.Enduring_Destroyed}Understood.  Destroying those artillery units were brutal.
{MC.If.Encounter.HasTag.Enduring_Destroyed}We figured.  Thanks for knocking those guns out --- saved what was left of us.
{MC.If.Encounter.HasTag.Enduring_Destroyed}Commander {COMMANDER.Callsign}, good job.  We'll take it from here.  Other Buffalo and Cutlass elements are en route now that the artillery are gone.
{MC.If.Encounter.HasNoTag.Enduring_Destroyed}Commander {COMMANDER.Callsign}, we'll take it from here.  Other Buffalo and Cutlass elements are still en route still dodging artillery fire.
{MC.Modification.AddTo.EncounterTags.Enduring_Destroyed}Grim Determination's (Wave 1) artillery lance destroyed.
The Task Force's reinforcements shouldn't have any more problems with constant artillery barrage, and should arrive soon.
Another group of Band of Damned entering the perimeter.
Grim Determination's Steel Dominion lance are charging downhill, joining the fray.  Keep our six covered, team!
<color=#85DBF6FF>Band of the Damned:</color> C'mon...we'll break through the line.  Where are the other Band?

<color=#85DBF6FF>Grim Determination:</color> We'll crush you, and be literally Damned!  Consider this the reward for your betrayal!

The Grim Determination, is determined to see this through!
This sounds like cheesy lines from some movie...
More Grim Determination hostiles coming up the hill!
This appears to be the last of the Band of the Damned --- the others are still in Corrigan's battlefield.
Grim Determination's in our scopes, they seem to be the final group.

{MC.Modification.AddTo.EncounterTags.megakill}{MC.Modification.AddTo.CompanyTags.CIAM_megakill}Outstanding work, Commander {COMMANDER.Callsign}.  We make a pretty good team.

Thanks for staying and fight with my men.

We've marked your rally location.

You may leave this area of operations.
However, we'd really appreciate it if you can hold the area with my boys longer...your choice, no judgement either way.
